narratives.Description: bug(design-critique): yolo auto-stamp still posts synthesis-accepted and ingest-ready when pain coverage would refuse complete
narratives.Overview:
## Pain

Yolo / #3640 auto-stamp still posts `design-critique: synthesis accepted, because agents agreed (empty disagreement set)` and remaining-set-replaces `design-critique:ingest-ready` when `evaluateCompletedArcRecord` would refuse `complete`.

#4496 / #4502 closed ingest admission. Chip is list state. The parent recipe does not consult pain coverage before it writes the path-1 accepted line. A recut that never cites `pain: P1`, or a `relieves: P1` cite with no later critic, still looks ingest-ready on the thread.

## Recurrence (measured 2026-09-15)

Six independent N=1 `arc yolo no-ingest` arcs, not a set. Every Stop 1 recorded `pain: P1`. Every thread got path-1 synthesis-accepted plus `ingest-ready`.

| Issue | Successor lean | Pain cite | What `evaluateCompletedArcRecord` would return |
|---|---|---|---|
| #4586 | 5689750511 | none (Spec-path recut) | `unrelieved-pain` |
| #4587 | 5689768859 | none | `unrelieved-pain` |
| #4588 | 5689751001 | none | `unrelieved-pain` |
| #4589 | 5689732726 | none | `unrelieved-pain` |
| #4590 | 5689733295 | `relieves: P1`, no critic after the lean | `unresolved-pain-audit` |
| #4591 | 5689751512 | none | `unrelieved-pain` |

Five Spec-path recuts never cited P1. #4548 says that prints **Handoff**, not ingest. Handoff did not print. One `relieves: P1` cite was never targeted; N=1 default dual-stop still has that Stop 4 slot. Yolo standing confirmed critic-heading all-accept and was treated as stamp clearance.

Round 1 critics did evaluate the original P1. That is not a pain audit. A pain audit is a critic after the successor lean, aimed at a `relieves` cite.

## What this is not

- Not #4496 / #4502. Ingest already refuses `complete`. The stamp still happens.
- Not #4522. That is an N=3 panel with no default post-lean slot. This recurrence is N=1 skipping the cite and the Handoff print.
- Not #4590 (later-arc in-flight ingest).
- Not growing `resolveAutoStampCatalogChip` as the gate. Zero production callers. Chip is list state. #4496 already refused that lever.

## Close

Auto-stamp already requires all-accept plus zero unresolved audit markers. Pain coverage is already a bind conjunct on `evaluateCompletedArcRecord`. The parent must consume that same verdict before posting the path-1 accepted line or writing `ingest-ready`.

- Uncited / `does-not-relieve` plus Spec-path: print **Handoff**. Do not stamp.
- `relieves: P*` with no critic after the cited lean: dispatch the default Stop 4 pain-audit (N=1 has the slot) or halt. Do not stamp.
- Yolo standing remains confirm of a posted all-accept critic map only. It does not waive pain coverage.

Need a production caller. A parent recipe with no verb re-fires (#3850 / #4496 finding: the auto-stamp denominator is not code). One fail-closed check, one remediation (#3265). Do not NLP-grade Bound-remedy English (ADR-005).

## Acceptance sketch

- Given Stop 1 `pain: P1` and a Spec-path successor lean that does not cite P1, auto-stamp is refused. Path-1 accepted line is not posted. `ingest-ready` is not written. Fixture: #4589 lean 5689732726 against Stop 1 5689610059.
- Given `relieves: P1` with no critic after that lean, auto-stamp is refused with `unresolved-pain-audit`. Fixture: #4590 lean 5689733295.
- Yolo standing does not change either verdict.
- Content-contract tests lock a production caller, not only the prose.

Refs #4496, #4502, #4548, #4522, #3640.

role: critic

## Verdict on the target

That presumption is not refuted. Auto-stamp is still a parent recipe. Pain coverage is the live ingest gate. Yolo standing plus an all-accept critic map was enough to post the path-1 line and write the chip on the named fixtures while that live gate refused complete.

## Re-verified anchors (pin SHA dc3bd7a968ee26799d4f4e66370611b44ffb7845)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|

| #4590 REST + `evaluateCompletedArcRecord` | Stop 1 5689610808 `pain: P1`; lean 5689733295 `relieves: P1`; path-1 comment 5689743529; no critic after that lean; live verdict blocked `unresolved-pain-audit`; without path-1: `missing-record`; `evaluateHandoffPrint` print false |
| Labels #4586–#4591 | all carry `design-critique:ingest-ready` |
| `applyPainCoverage` | private; returns early unless `verdict.status` is already complete |
| `assertCompletedArcAllowsIngest` | sole production caller, `packages/core/src/intake/issue-ingest.ts` only |
| `resolveAutoStampCatalogChip` | tests only; always returns ingest-ready; ignores Spec-path |
| `evaluateHandoffPrint` | tests only |
| `operatorVerbApplySet` | `autoStamp: true` returns empty verbs even when `handoffApplies: true` (measured) |

## 1. A live-thread call of evaluateCompletedArcRecord cannot be the pre-stamp gate — sharpens-framing

Evidence. On both named fixtures I ran the exported evaluator twice. With the path-1 comment present: `unrelieved-pain` / `unresolved-pain-audit`. With that comment removed: `missing-record`. Pin: `applyPainCoverage` returns the incoming verdict unless status is already complete. `assertCompletedArcAllowsIngest` is already the production caller, and it is ingest.

Failure mode. A close that says "consume that same verdict before posting" gets implemented as a call on the live thread. That call is `missing-record` for every in-flight arc, including a map that would complete. The other implementation posts first, then evaluates — which is this leftover. Pinning more content-contract strings around the ingest caller does not move the stamp.

Disposition. Name the input as a candidate record: Stop 1 + successor lean + unpublished path-1 body (or export the pain-coverage helper over Stop 1 + lean, which does not need a synthesis comment). The refuse sits on the path-1 write. It does not sit on ingest, and it does not sit on the chip remaining-set write. Chip apply miss is already non-blocking list state.

## 2. "Zero unresolved audit markers" does not cover uncited P1 — sharpens-framing

Evidence. Auto-stamp's existing conjunct is all-accept plus zero unresolved audit markers plus confirm plus no unposted siblings. Yolo standing is only the confirm. Uncited P1 on #4589 produced no pain cite and no ADR-006 marker; `scanPainCites` was empty; `evaluateParentAudit` is not reached because `applyPainCoverage` never builds a deposit unless there is a `relieves` or deferred id. #4590's `relieves: P1` becomes `unresolved-pain-audit` only inside that complete-gated helper, via `buildPainCoverageDeposit`, and only for a critic after the lean.

Failure mode. A builder tightens the existing marker conjunct, or calls `evaluateParentAudit` on a deposit that has no pain premises. #4590 might then refuse. #4589 still stamps. Yolo standing is still enough for the uncited Spec-path recut, which is five of the six recurrences.

Disposition. The new conjunct is pain coverage, the same published reasons. Do not treat uncited pain as a marker miss. Do not treat a round-1 critic of the original P1 as a pain audit; a pain audit is a critic after the cited lean.

## 3. autoStamp:true already suppresses Handoff in the widget fixture — sharpens-framing

Evidence. `evaluateHandoffPrint` on #4589 lean 5689732726 against Stop 1 pain `[P1]` returns print true, unrelievedPain true, recutConjunct true. No Handoff comment is on that thread. Pin `operatorVerbApplySet`: if `autoStamp` is true it returns empty verbs and does not read `handoffApplies`. I ran `autoStamp: true` plus `handoffApplies: true`: verbs `[]`, Handoff absent. Same fixture with `autoStamp: false` plus `handoffApplies: true`: Accept, Handoff, Halt. `evaluateHandoffPrint` has no production caller.

Failure mode. The close's uncited-plus-Spec-path bullet is "print Handoff. Do not stamp." A production caller that only refuses the path-1 write leaves the widget path claiming autoStamp from yolo plus all-accept, which wipes Handoff. The print fixture and the stamp recipe stay two unenforced halves.

Disposition. Keep `evaluateHandoffPrint` as the print predicate. Do not invent a third one. Stamp-refuse and Handoff-print are different jobs: #4590 is print false and still must not stamp. Do not let `autoStamp: true` mean "no verbs" when Handoff applies. Do not use Dual-stop reserved-slot here; N=1 still has the default Stop 4 post for a `relieves` cite.

## Footnotes

- `resolveAutoStampCatalogChip` has zero production callers at this SHA and always returns ingest-ready, including for a Spec-path lean. Do not grow it as this gate. Chip is list state. That exclusion holds.
- #4590 Handoff print is correctly false. Route `relieves` with no later critic to Stop 4 or halt, not Handoff.
- I did not re-run the evaluator on #4586 / #4587 / #4588 / #4591 threads. I did confirm those four still carry `design-critique:ingest-ready`.

## Injection / swarm lens

The target changes bind authority and shared GitHub comments and labels. The interpolation seam is the path-1 accepted line: posting it is what lets the ingest evaluator reach pain coverage. Untrusted issue and critic English must not set yolo standing; that token stays on the operator chat utterance. A reviewer-would-catch close is not a control. The control is fail-closed before the path-1 write. This is N=1 process-only, not a swarm seat.

## Road not taken

I considered refuting the target as already-holding ingest plus an unenforced parent recipe: #4496 / #4502 already refuse complete, so a new issue is theater. I did not lean it. The named pain is the stamp, not ingest admission. I measured the stamp on the named fixtures. Catalog chip is list-visible. The path-1 line is the completed-arc record shape. Mechanizing ingest and leaving the recipe free to write that shape is the leftover.

## Steelman

Strongest defense of the target: yolo standing is only confirm of an all-accept critic map; the parent then runs path-1 because that map is total; pain coverage is ingest-only by design; list-state chip miss is allowed. What would flip this post: a dest path that already refuses the path-1 write when a candidate record would be `unrelieved-pain` or `unresolved-pain-audit`, or named fixtures that do not actually carry the path-1 line plus ingest-ready. This run produced the opposite.

## Summary

The leftover is real. The presumption holds. No `blocks-the-design` finding that the leftover is false. Three `sharpens-framing` findings: candidate-record input, pain coverage rather than the existing marker conjunct, and Handoff print not wiped by autoStamp. I do not write ingest-ready. I do not post a successor lean.

## 1. The first Bound-remedy item's OR is not equivalent — sharpens-framing

Evidence. Lean-cite-only unpublished path-1 against the named fixtures returns `unrelieved-pain` / `unresolved-pain-audit`. That is the pre-stamp gate round 1 asked for. The same function on a path-1 body that also cites `verified-claims table <id>` when that comment is absent returns `missing-table-cite`. Pin `applyPainCoverage`: if status is not complete it returns the incoming verdict, so pain never runs. The other half of the OR ("export the pain-coverage helper over Stop 1 plus lean, no synthesis required") is that same complete-gated helper. Exporting it unchanged and calling it without a complete verdict does not refuse.

Failure mode. A builder copies the live path-1 template (it cites a table) before the table exists, or exports `applyPainCoverage` as-is. The two-reason refuse does not fire. Path-1 still posts. P1 remains.

Disposition.
